fixes.explanation: No altars come up in this verse, friend. If the prophet wanted an altar on every hill, that would be a whole lot of hills and a whole lot of stone hauling, and I can't even keep my own counter clean. What he asks is “Let us follow other gods (which you have not known) and let us worship them…” His ask is about following and worshiping.

Priests don't show up in this verse, friend. Nobody gets a cut here, not even the priests. Moses says the city and everything taken from it goes up “…as a whole burnt offering to the LORD your God.” Whole means whole, so there's no leftover pile to hand out.
